compute_ranking: compute the leaderboard ranking of agents based on average KL divergence with configurable normalization
display_ranking_df: display a formatted leaderboard ranking dataframe with selected columns for agents
compute_normalization: compute the normalization score from a baseline agent's mean KL estimate at a given tau
compute_mean: compute the mean of a specified column grouped by agent name from a leaderboard dataframe
compute_stderr: compute the standard error of KL estimates grouped by agent name and seed classes
